race.comment: I'VE FORGOTTEN (6) showed some nice improvement at his most recent outing. He sat up near the speed and ran away from them late. Have to think that from this draw, he can do a similar thing against the older horses. SAKER FALCON (1) has been looking like winning a race all campaign and did it at Wagga. He does like his runs spaced so the month between runs is no issue. The little weight off should improve his hopes too. IMPOSING TALLULAH (11) comes off a win in the country but was showing a lift in form to that stage. Should be near the speed most of the way and can hang about. MISHIMA (2) does love racing here. He too will be up with the leaders to run you a race. SALINA SPECIAL (3) was only plain first up so trialled since. Form last prep was decent enough to place.
